scope: Deterministic instances of original properties: real PropEr replay on BEAM, external closure adapter on Nera; no native PropEr claim.
root_cause: Minor GC skips old container contents but previously swept binary backing stores using only pointers encountered during that partial traversal. Backing storage referenced by a live old match context could be freed and reused.
fix: Track backing stores promoted to old generation. Preserve them across minor collections and recompute the set on major collection; unreachable young stores remain reclaimable.

corpus.algorithm: SHAKE-256 plus explicit byte/boundary patterns; framed with uint32 big-endian lengths

cowlib_corpus.scope: Existing 122-case comparison contract unchanged, including Set-Cookie attribute order and positive Max-Age time windows.

checks.minimal_regression: minor_gc_preserves_binary_behind_old_match_context fails before the fix with live binary backing was freed; passes after.
checks.lifecycle_regression: minor_gc_retains_nested_old_binaries_but_sweeps_young_garbage covers nested map/list/tuple storage, young garbage, retention across minor GC, and final release on major GC.
checks.native_regressions: base64_options, binary_refc, binary_referenced_byte_size, binary_rest_multi_use, closure_gc: passed

separate_observation.scope: Existing-variable binary matching, not fixed or claimed by this GC change.
separate_observation.description: During reduction, B = binary:copy(<<N>>, N) fails with badmatch in this generated-frame loop, while true = B =:= binary:copy(<<N>>, N) succeeds. The original upstream properties use equality. The same match form failed before and after the GC fix. Root cause not established.
separate_observation.project_owned_reproducer:
%% EXPECT: ok
%% Keep the unread binary behind a match context across allocating calls.
-module(binary_gc_retention).
-export([test/0]).

test() ->
    Frames = iolist_to_binary([<<N:32, (binary:copy(<<N>>, N))/binary>>
                              || N <- lists:seq(0, 128)]),
    129 = consume(Frames, 0),
    io:format("ok~n").

consume(<<>>, Count) -> Count;
consume(<<N:32, B:N/binary, Rest/binary>>, Count) ->
    B = binary:copy(<<N>>, N),
    Encoded = base64:encode(B, #{mode => urlsafe}),
    B = base64:decode(Encoded, #{mode => urlsafe}),
    consume(Rest, Count + 1).

limitations: Local macOS arm64 / OTP 29.0.5 only; no remote Linux verdict for this fix yet.
Nera executes original predicates through the external macro adapter, not native PropEr generation or shrinking.
Old-generation backing stores may remain until major GC, matching the lifetime of their untraversed descriptors. No performance benchmark was run.
No claim for all Cowlib modules; separate existing-variable binary matching observation remains open.
